brief: Phase: code review. Role of the person asking: reviewer. Repo kind: a Node.js backend for a subscription app with an in-house feature flag module (flag file, evaluation, percentage rollout), billing, tests, docs. The PR puts a new billing flow behind a flag and starts a 10% rollout. Plant: the flag default is on when the flag file lacks the key, so every environment without the new key gets the new flow; one code path checks the flag inverted; percentage bucketing uses Math.random per request, so a user flips between flows; the flag is read once at module load, so the kill switch the docs describe needs a restart; the old and new flows write different invoice number formats that the docs say must stay one sequence; tests only run with the flag on. Add one decoy.
